name: brewos
description: Brewery management for Finnish craft breweries: production, tanks, stock, shipments, invoicing and regulatory reporting.

interface.longDescription:
BrewOS is brewery management software (ERP) for craft breweries in Finland. This plugin lets brewery staff run their BrewOS account from ChatGPT: see what is fermenting in each tank, check stock, prepare and follow customer shipments and invoices, and pull the sales and tax figures the brewery reports to the authorities.

What you can do:
- Production: recipes, batches in progress, the tank map, measurements and packaging
- Stock: product and ingredient stock by warehouse, low and expiring stock
- Sales: customers and their licensed outlets, shipments, invoices and payments
- Reports: sales by product or customer, stock value, excise and Lupa- ja valvontavirasto (Valvira) reporting data

Who it is for: breweries and beverage wholesalers that use BrewOS. You sign in with your own BrewOS account, and ChatGPT gets only the permissions your BrewOS role has, in the brewery account you choose when connecting. Tools that change or remove data are marked so ChatGPT asks before using them; the EMCS tools file excise movement documents with the Finnish Tax Administration only when you ask. You can revoke access at any time under Settings > AI agents in BrewOS.

BrewOS is a business tool for licensed alcohol producers and wholesalers. It does not sell alcohol to consumers.
capabilities: Create and follow shipments and invoices
Run sales, stock and excise reports
defaultPrompt: What's in our tanks right now?
Which products are running low on stock?
Which shipments are waiting to be picked?

positive.prompt: What's in our tanks right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brewery's tanks (T1-T12 in Käymöhalli and Lagerkellari) with their state, and for each busy tank the batch, the beer and its current production step.

positive.prompt: Which of our products have 10 units or fewer in stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the low-stock report with threshold 10 for products and lists each product at or below it with its stock, or says that none are.

positive.prompt: Which shipments are waiting to be picked in the warehouse?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the shipments in state waiting_warehouse (for example Hotelli Järvenranta, Lähikauppa Lehtonen, Bar Kuohu and Olutravintola Kaski) with customer, shipment number and total in euros.

positive.prompt: What were our best-selling products over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the product sales report once for the last 30 days and ranks the products by units and euros sold.

positive.prompt: Create a draft shipment for Bar Kuohu with 2 kegs of Havu NEIPA.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the customer Bar Kuohu and the Havu NEIPA keg product, then creates a draft shipment with 2 kegs and reports its number. A draft moves no stock and delivers or invoices nothing.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Helsinki tomorrow?
Transfer 500 euros from our bank account to Pohjan Rosteri Oy.
Show me the sales figures of another brewery that uses BrewOS.

review.commerce_description: BrewOS does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. It records the brewery's own business-to-business shipments and invoices.

publication.release_notes: First release: production, tanks, stock, shipments, invoicing and reports of your BrewOS brewery account.

fi-FI.subtitle: Panimon toiminnanohjaus
fi-FI.description:
BrewOS on suomalaisten pienpanimoiden toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä. Tällä liitännäisellä panimon väki hoitaa BrewOS-tiliään ChatGPT:ssä: näet, mitä kussakin tankissa käy, tarkistat varastot, valmistelet ja seuraat asiakastoimituksia ja laskuja ja haet myynti- ja verotiedot, jotka panimo ilmoittaa viranomaisille. Tietoja voi kysyä ja päivittää tavallisella kielellä: reseptit, käynnissä olevat erät, tankkikartta, mittaukset ja astiointi; tuote- ja raaka-ainevarastot; asiakkaat ja anniskelupaikat, toimitukset, laskut ja suoritukset; myynti-, varasto-, valmistevero- ja Lupa- ja valvontaviraston raportointitiedot.

Kirjaudut omalla BrewOS-tunnuksellasi. ChatGPT saa vain BrewOS-roolisi oikeudet siihen panimotiliin, jonka valitset yhdistäessäsi. Tietoja muuttavat ja poistavat työkalut on merkitty niin, että ChatGPT kysyy ennen niiden käyttöä. Voit perua pääsyn milloin tahansa BrewOSin kohdasta Asetukset > AI-agentit.

BrewOS on yritysten työkalu luvanhaltijoille. Se ei myy alkoholia kuluttajille.

sv-SE.subtitle: Affärssystem för bryggerier
sv-SE.description:
BrewOS är ett affärssystem för finländska hantverksbryggerier. Med det här tillägget sköter bryggeriets personal sitt BrewOS-konto i ChatGPT: se vad som jäser i varje tank, kontrollera lagret, förbered och följ kundleveranser och fakturor och hämta de försäljnings- och skatteuppgifter bryggeriet rapporterar till myndigheterna. Uppgifterna kan frågas om och uppdateras med vanligt språk: recept, pågående satser, tankkartan, mätningar och tappning; produkt- och råvarulager; kunder och serveringsställen, leveranser, fakturor och betalningar; försäljnings-, lager-, punktskatte- och tillstånds- och tillsynsverkets rapportuppgifter.

Du loggar in med ditt eget BrewOS-konto. ChatGPT får bara de behörigheter din roll i BrewOS har, i det bryggerikonto du väljer när du kopplar. Verktyg som ändrar eller tar bort uppgifter är märkta så att ChatGPT frågar innan de används. Du kan återkalla åtkomsten när som helst under Inställningar > AI-agenter i BrewOS.

BrewOS är ett verktyg för företag med tillstånd. Det säljer inte alkohol till konsumenter.
